name: drqv2-steering-logit-proposal-v1
status: proposal only; not implemented or launched
motivation: The final actor has large pre-tanh steering logits and mostly vanishing squash derivatives on retained replay, with similar saturation on fresh cells. No measured systematic Q1-only optimism or dominant final-policy gas/brake conflict singles out another repair.
causality_caveat: Confirmation finishers are also highly steering-saturated. This tests gradient starvation, not an established causal explanation of crashes or off-track failures.

single_change.actor_objective: existing negative Q1 objective + steering_logit_l2 * mean(pre_tanh_steering_logit ** 2)
single_change.coefficient_rationale: Fixed before any trial, not optimized on confirmation: at |logit|=10 this adds a 0.1 per-state penalty and a direct 0.02 logit gradient where the squash path can vanish. This scale is a testable choice, not established optimality.

matched_design.other_learning_parameters: Freeze the pilot values and corrected replay/RNG implementation identically for both arms. Do not compare the treatment only to the historical dirty-source pilot.

evaluation.selection_cells: Existing consumed screen IDs101-103 x seeds31001-31008, same for both arms, exported CPU21 actors only
evaluation.training_exclusion: Before launch, freeze an executable protocol excluding all old and new reserved geometry seeds across every track ID; the current trainer protocol schema must explicitly carry this full reservation set.
evaluation.consumed_confirmation: 31101-31108 must never be advertised as fresh again
evaluation.confirmation_selection: Freeze actor hashes from the screen before confirmation; do not select a checkpoint or alter coefficients on confirmation/blind results

acceptance.primary: Repeated nonzero unseen completion across training seeds and improved finish outcomes against the matched control; progress alone is insufficient
acceptance.mechanistic: Measure pre-tanh logits, squash derivatives and saturation without treating their reduction alone as success
acceptance.failure: If the mechanistic metrics improve but completion does not, reject this repair hypothesis instead of sweeping the coefficient
acceptance.operational: Preserve restore parity, CPU21 reset/action trace reproducibility, resource limits and immutable selection artifacts
